title: Before putting more money behind any ad be sure to check your frequen...
description: Before putting more money behind any ad be sure to check your frequency.  #metaadstips #facebookadvertisingtips #metaadsspecialist #facebookadstips #metaads
transcript: I just took over an account spending $50,000 per month on meta and this was the biggest mistake I saw and really the biggest mistake I'm seeing everyone make in their ad account and that is scaling an ad that shouldn't be scaled. Now let me walk you through exactly what I mean. So when you look at your top ad you may look at what your C P a is and how many purchases you get and you go fantastic, I am going to scale this either within this ad set or into a separate campaign, a scaling campaign. But what people fail to actually look at is the frequency of this ad because this could be disguised at as a bottom of funnel ad that is great getting a great C P a great results for you and you think well if I put it out on its own or potentially scale it up further it's going to yield these best results. But the reason that this ad is doing so well is because of the top of the funnel creative that is fueling it and it's actually disguised as a top ad but really a retargeting ad. So I would be looking at a 7 day period and if the ad is already over 2, 2.53 you have obviously a retargeting ad and then looking at even the 14 and the 30 if those numbers are looking even higher then this is a retargeting ad and shouldn't Be scaled. It should definitely be replicated and iterated on because we need these ads, of course, into the answer set, but it shouldn't be one that should be scaled in Silo or scaled in general.
